archetype: Organic & Earthy with High-Contrast Swiss accents (Custom blend for Premium Mountain Travel)

typography.instructions: Use font families through Expo Fonts (e.g., useFonts hook for PlayfairDisplay_700Bold and Inter_400Regular). All headings must use the Serif font, maintaining strong tracking-tight properties. Only use sans-serif for body text, UI elements, and data.

buttons.primary: bg-[#10B981] rounded-full px-6 py-4 flex-row justify-center items-center shadow-sm

cards.ticket: bg-[#111111] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-md overflow-hidden flex-col gap-4
cards.trip_item: bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-sm mb-4 flex-row justify-between items-center
cards.from_to_selector: bg-white rounded-xl p-5 border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-sm flex-col gap-3

chips.inactive: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-full px-5 py-2

seat_picker.seat_available: w-12 h-12 bg-white border-2 border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg items-center justify-center
seat_picker.seat_selected: w-12 h-12 bg-[#10B981] border-2 border-[#10B981] rounded-lg items-center justify-center shadow-sm
seat_picker.seat_booked: w-12 h-12 bg-[#F3F4F6] border-2 border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg items-center justify-center opacity-60
seat_picker.layout: Grid mimicking a 7-seater SUV (Row 1: Driver + 1 Passenger, Row 2: 3 Passengers, Row 3: 2 Passengers)

bottom_tabs.container: bg-white border-t border-[#E5E7EB] pt-3 pb-8 px-6 flex-row justify-between

screens.home: Features a prominent 'Book a Seat' big serif header. Contains a From/To selector card. Followed by a Horizontal ScrollView of date chips. Below is a vertical list of available trips (Uttarkashi ↔ Dehradun/Rishikesh) showing seats left, time, and green price tags.
screens.find_taxi: Search interface with route filters (Origin, Destination, Date, Passengers) and a 'Search Taxis' primary CTA button at the bottom.
screens.trip_detail: Details of the trip. Visual seat map using a 7-seater SUV layout. Cost summary fixed at the bottom with a 'Proceed to Book' sticky CTA.
screens.ticket_confirmation: The signature 'Black Card' screen. Full black card holding the booking reference, route, timings, and a barcode icon. Highly premium and high contrast.
screens.my_bookings: List of upcoming and past trips using standard white cards.
screens.driver_dashboard: Driver view listing passengers for their assigned trip, with a prominent 'Confirm Trip' button.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'testID' attribute (since this is React Native, use testID instead of data-testid).

himalayan_road.description: Scenic view of a winding road in the mountains, used for empty states, profile banners, or header backgrounds.

suv_mountain.description: White SUV driving on a highway with mountains. Used in trip detail views to showcase the vehicle type.

driver_avatar.description: Friendly smiling driver portrait for the driver profile or trip details showing the assigned driver.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: React Native (Expo) using expo-router. Use .js extension (not .tsx) as requested.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) or standard React Native StyleSheet. The provided classes map directly to Tailwind/NativeWind. If NativeWind isn't configured, translate these classes to StyleSheet objects.
instructions_to_main_agent.typography_loading: Implement expo-font to load 'Playfair Display' (Serif) and 'Inter' (Sans). Handle loading state securely.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Use 'testID' (React Native standard) strictly instead of data-testid. Apply to all interactable UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Set up a bottom tab navigator for (Home, Find a Taxi, My Bookings, Profile) and separate stack screens for (TripDetail, SeatPicker, TicketConfirmation, DriverDashboard) using expo-router structure.
